svg.title: A parametric path traced as t increases, and a vector with its components
svg.desc: Left: the path x = t squared minus 2t, y = 3 minus t for t from -1 to 3, with dots at t = -1 (3, 4), t = 0 (0, 3), t = 1 (-1, 2), t = 2 (0, 1) and t = 3 (3, 0), and arrows showing the point moves down the page, first left and then right. Right: the vector from P(1, 1) to Q(4, 5), with dashed components 3 across and 4 up; it is the vector 3, 4 and its length is 5.

text.tspan: The vector from P to Q: ⟨4 − 1, 5 − 1⟩ = ⟨3, 4⟩
Left: each t gives one point; the arrows show the direction of increasing t. Right: a vector is a horizontal and a vertical change.
